questions.markdown:
The equation of two regression lines obtained in a correlation analysis is as follows: $3x + 2y = 19$,

$3y + 9x = 46$

(I) Obtain mean of $x$ and $y$

(II) Obtain the value of correlation coefficient

Fit the equation of the form $y = ax + b$ to the following data:

| $x$ | 1 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 7 | 8 |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| $y$ | 2.4 | 3 | 3.6 | 4 | 5 | 6 |

It is suspected that a patient has one of the diseases $A1, A2, A3$. Suppose that the population suffering from this illness are in the ratio $2:1:1$. The patient is given a test which turns out to be positive in 25% of the cases of $A1$, 50% of the cases of $A2$ and 90% of the cases of $A3$. Given that out of 3 tests taken by the patient two are positive, then find the probability for each of the diseases.

The random variable $(X, Y)$ has a joint pdf given by

$$
f(x,y)=x+y,\ 0\le x\le 1,\ 0\le y\le 1.
$$

Compute the correlation coefficient between $X$ and $Y$.

reviewNotes: The symbol under the fraction in the pdf appears to be $a^2$; the source is slightly blurred but readable.

questions.markdown: The times to failure in months $X$ of the light bulbs produced at two manufacturing plants A and B of a company obey exponential distributions with means 5 and 2 months respectively. Plant B produces three times as many bulbs as Plant A. The company mixes the produced bulbs at both the plants before selling. What is the probability that a randomly selected bulb from the mixed lot will work for at least 5 months?

The number of telephone lines busy at an instant of time is a binomial variate with a probability of 0.2. If at an instant 10 lines are chosen at random, what is the probability that

(I) No line is busy

(II) At least one line is busy

(III) At most two lines are busy
Derive an expression for expectation of a continuous random variable having Chi-square distribution with $n$ degree of freedom $\left(\chi^2_{(n)}\right)$.
If $X$ and $Y$ are independent random variables and have exponential distributions with parameter 1, find the pdf of $U = X - Y$.

reviewNotes: The exponent in the pdf is slightly blurry in the source; it appears to be $x$ and $1-x$ as transcribed.

$$

$$
